Passage: Good news has arrived for stranded holidaymakers after Virgin Australia and Jetstar officially announced that conditions were safe to resume flights to and from Bali. Earlier on Saturday, Indonesian officials declared Denpasar Airport safe to reopen as the cloud of ash from the eruption of Mount Raung drifted away. Virgin sent an observation flight to the airport to have visual confirmation and determine whether conditions were suitable for flights to operate before giving the all-clear. The airline said scheduled flights out of Denpasar would go ahead on Saturday evening and it plans to continue operations in and out of the Indonesian island on Sunday.
@highlight
Virgin Australia and Jetstar has confirmed it is able to resume flights
@highlight

@highlight

@highlight

@highlight

@highlight

Query: The ash grounded planes from Virgin, @placeholder, Garuda and AirAsia on Friday.

Options : A. Mount Raung
B. Denpasar
C. Virgin Australia
D. Bali
E. Virgin
F. Australians
G. Indonesian
H. Jetstar
I. Denpasar Airport

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
